description: This file defines a TraceLoader class responsible for loading and processing trace data, including reading trace files, managing resources, and constructing context entries for trace analysis in a testing or debugging environment.

classes.name: TraceLoader
classes.description: A class for loading and processing trace data, managing context entries, resources, and trace modernization.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads trace data from a backend, processes trace files, and updates internal state.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific trace entry exists in the backend.

methods.name: resourceForSha1
methods.description: Retrieves a resource blob by its SHA-1 hash and wraps it with content type if available.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotStorage instance used by the loader.
